section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1986
title: 19 causes of 14.5% suicides remained unknown. Among the important causes of suicides 'Dreadful Diseases' was the major cause of suicides during 1986 which accounted for 13.3% of the total suicides. The second important cause of suicides was 'Quarrel With Parents-inlaw' (7.5%) followed by 'Quarrel With Spouse' (5.5%), 'Love Affairs' (4.9%), 'Insanity' (3.6%), 'Poverty' (2.5%), 'Dispute Over Property' (2.1%), 'Failure In Examination' (1.9%), 'Unemployment' (1.5%), 'Dowry Disputes' (1.3%) and 'Bankruptcy Or Sudden Change In Economic Position' (1.2%). The remaining causes of suicides shared less than 1.0% of the total suicides in India during 1986. The detailed statistics are presented in Table-III.
